title: Strict etale system interfaces
statement: For a scheme $T$ and a commutative ring $O$ with element $e$, use the strict coefficient systems of [lem-pur-coefficient-system-derived-comparison], with positive levels $O/(e^{n+1})$. Define strictEtaleCoefficientSystem, strictEtaleLevel and StrictEtaleEvaluation by specializing that interface to the small etale site. For a compactification $c=(j,p)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], StrictEtaleCompactSupport is the type of ordinary open extension and proper image, their universal derived images, endpoint evaluation packages, ordinary and derived adjunctions, and the representative and transpose equations fixing their canonical comparisons. Its functor is derivedOpen followed by properDerived.system.direct; its levelFunctor is levelDerivedOpen followed by properDerived.level.direct. Its evaluation is the composite of the recorded open and proper evaluation isomorphisms. StrictEtaleScalarAction is multiplication by $r\in O$ on every section through the actual constant-ring unit, localized termwise. These are interfaces specifying data and normalizations, with no existence assertion and no finite-field restriction.

source.place: Construction 4.1 and Constructions 5.14–5.15, Lemma 5.16: definitions of strict systems and simultaneous compact support
